input: Research van conversion kits for a campervan build

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Conversion kits range from full all-in-one systems (bed, kitchen, storage) to single-component kits (just a bed platform or just a kitchen unit). Knowing which components are needed narrows the research significantly.

Whether this is for a solo traveller, a couple, or a family changes the space requirements, sleeping configuration, and kit sizing — a couple needs a fixed double bed, a family needs bunk options, etc.
The van make and model (e.g. Ford Transit, VW Transporter, Mercedes Sprinter) determines which kits are compatible, since most manufacturers design for specific van dimensions and wheel arches.
Budget is a hard limit — full modular kits can range from a few hundred to tens of thousands of dollars/pounds. Knowing the budget filters out entire tiers of options.
Whether the user wants to self-install a flat-pack kit, have it professionally fitted, or buy a pre-built pop-up unit affects which products and suppliers are relevant.
Intended use — weekend trips vs. full-time van life vs. overlanding — drives priorities like durability, off-grid capability, insulation level, and storage volume.
The desired output of this research task matters: is the user building a shortlist to buy from, writing a comparison, seeking a single recommendation, or just exploring what exists?

gold.taskTitle: Research van conversion kits for a campervan build
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate van conversion kit options suitable for a DIY or semi-DIY campervan build.

questions.title: Which specific van make and model are you converting?
questions.description: Identify the van (e.g. Ford Transit, Mercedes Sprinter, VW Transporter) so only compatible kits are researched, since most kits are model-specific.

questions.title: Which components does the kit need to include?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs a full conversion kit (bed, kitchen, storage, electrical) or only specific modules such as a bed platform or kitchen unit.

questions.title: How many people will the van need to sleep?
questions.description: Establish whether this is for solo travel, a couple, or a family, which directly affects sleeping layout, kit size, and the type of bed configuration needed.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the conversion kit?
questions.description: Set a clear budget ceiling to filter out products that are out of range, since kits span from a few hundred to well over ten thousand dollars.

questions.title: Will you self-install or have it professionally fitted?
questions.description: Clarify the installation approach, as some kits are designed for DIY flat-pack assembly while others require professional fitting or specialist tools.

questions.title: Is this for weekend trips, full-time living, or off-road use?
questions.description: Understand the primary use case to prioritise the right features — insulation, off-grid power, heavy-duty materials, or compact lightweight design.

questions.title: What does a useful end result from this research look like?
questions.description: Determine the desired output — a shortlist of kits to purchase from, a side-by-side comparison, a single top recommendation, or a broad market overview.
